title: Access and Benefit Sharing (ABS) Fee Calculation Slabs (2014 & 2024)
raw_text:
Guidelines on Access to Biological Resources and Associated Knowledge and Benefits Sharing Regulations:
1. Mode A (Purchase Price Option): Commercial user pays between 3.0% to 5.0% of the purchase price of the biological resource accessed from local communities / State Biodiversity Boards.
2. Mode B (Annual Ex-Factory Gross Sales Option for Finished Products):
   - Slabs on annual gross ex-factory sale of product:
     * Up to ₹1,00,00,000 (1 Crore): 0.1%
     * ₹1,00,00,001 to ₹3,00,00,000 (1-3 Crores): 0.2%
     * Above ₹3,00,00,000 (>3 Crores): 0.5%
3. Commercialization of IPR (Patents):
   - When applicant commercializes the patent directly: 0.2% to 1.0% of ex-factory sale.
   - When applicant licenses/transfers IPR to third party: 2.0% to 5.0% of upfront fee + 2.0% to 5.0% of annual royalty.
guidance: Engine uses these exact statutory formulas to calculate prospective ABS liability for Ayurvedic startup dossiers.
